entries.title: Kitchen: cook with the real cooking model
items: Kitchen row north of the spawn: 4 ingredient crates, board, pan, pot, counter
Names and star ratings come from the server's cooking simulation
Labels above food update live for every player
test: Potato crate (E), board 3 (sticks), pan 2 (golden): 'crispy fried potato sticks' with 4 stars
Pan 3 (dark) gives fewer stars than pan 2
Both players cook at the same time

entries.title: Money: buy, cook, sell
items: Everyone starts with $500; crates charge the grocer price
The counter plates and sells to NPC demand; better cooking pays more
One in-game hour per minute: demand refills, prices move
test: Golden fries sell for more than dark fries
A raw potato cannot be sold
Sell many of the same dish: the price drops, the next hour demand returns

entries.title: Controls: third-person camera, sprint, sneak, jump
items: Mouse turns the camera (cursor locked); Esc or Alt frees the cursor
WASD moves where the camera looks; Shift sprints, C sneaks, Space jumps
Your own movement is predicted, so it feels instant even with lag
test: Camera does not go through boxes or stations
Jump while carrying something: no bump at the top
Gamepad: sticks move and look, A/cross jumps, B/circle sneaks

entries.title: New HUD, F1 debug menu, this banner
items: Clean HUD: wallet, time of day, what you hold, station hints, sales toasts
All technical details moved to the debug menu: press F1
This banner shows what is new in each build; F2 opens it again
test: F1 toggles the debug menu, F2 reopens this banner, Enter closes it
Near a station the hint at the bottom shows its keys
Selling a dish shows a toast on the right

entries.title: Talk without voice: emotes, pings, quick chat
items: Hold G (gamepad LB), move the mouse to an emote, release: it shows above your head
Middle mouse (gamepad RB) pings where you look; double-click marks danger
Hold T and press 1-6 for quick chat lines (gamepad D-pad)
test: The other window sees your emote bubble and the ping pillar
Quick chat appears as a toast for nearby players
Spamming G or middle mouse gets limited after a few tries

entries.title: Meals: plating table and mixing bowl
items: Plating table and bowl next to the counter (end of the kitchen row)
E with food in hand puts it on the plate / in the bowl; E with empty hands takes the result
A plate with two or more things is a meal: it sells for about 3x a single snack
test: Golden fries + tomato slices on one plate, take it, sell it: about $1,400
Two players fill the same plate together
A finished plate cannot go onto another plate

entries.title: Customers: the town's demand walks in
items: NPC customers walk in from the east and queue at the counter with their wish above the head
Orange wants a meal, green a snack, blue a drink
Sell a dish: one customer takes it and leaves with 'Thanks!'; unserved ones leave at the next hour
test: At 08:00 a queue forms in front of the counter
Sell a meal: an orange customer leaves happy
Wait an in-game hour (1 minute): the queue changes

entries.title: Cooking takes time: switch on the pan and the pot
items: Pan and pot cook over time: E puts food in, E with empty hands takes it out
1 switches the pan or pot on and off; food only cooks while it is on (they start off)
The label shows what is inside and how far: raw, warming up, short, medium, long
Pan: 2 switches fry or saute (only while the pan is empty)
test: Potato sticks in the pan, press 1 (on), take out after about 25 s: 'crispy fried potato sticks'
Switch off with food inside: the label stops changing; switch on again and it goes on
Take food out right away: 'Too short', it comes back unchanged
A puts food in the pan, B takes it out: works for both players

entries.title: The kitchen and the street get real art
items: Kitchen stations are now stoves, cabinets and a bar instead of grey boxes (free CC0 models)
A short street east of the kitchen with a road, houses, a shop, street lights and trees
Movement, interaction range and cooking are unchanged
test: Walk along the kitchen row: every station shows a model and its label is readable
Walk to the counter: customers queue on the street side next to the road
Cook one dish end to end: it works as before
